name: Mudsnout Composite
summary: At Tarren Mill, Mudsnout Composite is bound for research into a new plague. Apothecary Lydon makes it from Mudsnout Blossoms gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills, then sends it to the Undercity.

sections.title: A Base for Decay
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon makes Mudsnout Composite from Mudsnout Blossoms gathered in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The paste is noxious on its own. Master Apothecary Faranell binds it with a colloid of decay, bringing forth its deadlier qualities. Together, the ingredients form a key chemical component in the Dark Lady's Elixir of Agony.

sections.title: Apothecary Correspondence
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society receives Mudsnout Composite in the Undercity's Apothecarium after it travels from Tarren Mill. Field researchers gather reagents in different regions and send samples to the capital's masters for refinement. Lady Sylvanas demands swift results against living humans and the Scourge. Faranell praises the composite as ingenious groundwork toward their goal.

faq.q: What is the Mudsnout Composite used for?
faq.answer: Mudsnout Composite is a paste made from Mudsnout Blossoms. In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell treats it with a colloid of decay to help formulate the Elixir of Agony.
Apothecary Lydon created the composite at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Lydon crushes fresh blossoms into a paste before sending it north.

faq.q: Why does Master Apothecary Faranell need it?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell needs the composite for the Royal Apothecary Society's work on a new plague. Lydon's paste gives their research into lethal toxins its herbal base.

angles.text: As an undead, you know each shipment of Mudsnout Composite serves the Dark Lady's mandate: securing the Forsaken's future with a plague against the living and the Scourge.
As a herbalist, you can see how an apothecary crushes Mudsnout Blossoms and turns them into a weapon.
